notes.title: Changelog February 27th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34233761/b3a874e8cd2b7c05972c422d3790ec7e6451314f.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Fixed several localization issues in the German version.
[*] Fixed an issue where Multiplayer was not available in the “Expansion Disc” and “Legends Expansion”.
[*] Fixed an issue where players did not leave the game lobby after accepting a new invite.
[*] Fixed an issue where the technology “Town watch” was unlocked but had no effect. It will now unlock the correct technology.
[*] Fixed an issue where a farmer spawned at the village centre to work as a barkeeper. It will now spawn the appropriate unit.
[/list]
Thanks to all the community contributions, bug and feedback reports. You made our life easier and we really appreciate your help.

For more informationen or helpful guides about The Settlers History Editions visit us on [url=www.thesettlers-alliance.com/en/]The Settlers Alliance[/url].
